nodes.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data.

A method and system in which a context-data type is determined from a query, context-data sources providing that type are identified, a request for context data is generated, and received context data is ranked according to a specified parameter.

A message received from a mobile device whose terms have meanings used to determine a context-data type.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device by a server, whose term meaning is used to determine a context-data type; context data may be associated with, appended to, encoded into, and forwarded along with the short message.<SEP>A message to which relevant context data is linked and which is formatted together with the context data according to a communication protocol.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device whose terms have meanings used to determine a context-data type; context data may be linked and formatted with it.

A mobile device that sends and receives short messages; may be a smart phone, and has states and an environment that provide context.<SEP>A device that generates a short message and query; context data may be provided to it, and it may be a recipient mobile device receiving context data.<SEP>A device that sends short messages and receives context data through a communication network; context data may be appended to short messages generated by the mobile device.

A server that receives a short message from a mobile device and performs context-data type determination, source identification, ranking, and request generation.<SEP>At least one server that collects a set of context data from at least one context-data provider.

A classification determined algorithmically from the meaning of a term of the short message, providing information about the environment or context of the mobile device.<SEP>A type of context data determined algorithmically by the meaning of a term of the short message, providing information about an environment of the mobile device.<SEP>A classification determined algorithmically by the meaning of a term of a short message, providing information about an environment of the mobile device.

A source that provides a context-data type and provides context data with an associated cost value.<SEP>A source that provides a context-data type and from which context data of that type is requested; sources may be ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost.<SEP>A source that provides a context-data type; it is algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter such as a pecuniary cost to acquire context data.

Data provided by a context-data source, having a type and a cost value, related to the context of a device.<SEP>Data of a determined context-data type received from a context-data source, which may be ranked, provided to devices, associated with a short message component, appended, encoded, stored, or forwarded.<SEP>Data of a context-data type requested from a context-data source, obtained by a physical sensor, and rendered or appended for communication to a mobile device.

A parameter used to algorithmically rank context-data sources; may comprise a state of the receiving mobile device, a state of an available communication network, or a cost value of the context data.<SEP>A parameter used to rank context-data sources, comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data, a state of the receiving mobile device, or a state of an available communication network.<SEP>A parameter used to algorithmically rank context-data sources, comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source.
A mobile device that receives context data, to which received context data and forwarded short messages may be provided.
A database available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored.

A server that stores a database queried for context data associated with a received short message.<SEP>A server whose Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) may be forwarded to the receiving mobile device.
An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to the receiving mobile device.
A language used to encode received context data into the short message.
Instructions appended to query the database for received context data in the short message.<SEP>Instructions appended to the short message to query the database for the received context data.
A cost to acquire context data from a context-data source, used as a specified parameter for ranking context-data sources.

An available communication network whose state may be a specified parameter for ranking context-data sources.<SEP>An available communication network whose state may serve as a specified parameter for ranking context-data sources.<SEP>A network through which context data from a context-data source is rendered for communication to a mobile device.
A type of mobile device that may generate the short message.
A medium comprising computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the method of claim 1.

An apparatus comprising at least one memory with program instructions and at least one processor configured to execute the program instructions to perform operations on short messages and context data.

At least one processor in the computerized apparatus configured to execute program instructions to perform operations.<SEP>At least one processor configured to execute program instructions to perform operations including receiving short messages, determining context-data types, identifying and ranking context-data sources, and generating context-data requests.
At least one memory in the computerized apparatus having program instructions.
Instructions executed by at least one processor to perform operations related to context data and short messages.
An entity that is allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.<SEP>A provider from which a set of context data related to a meaning of short message content is collected by at least one server.
A measure according to which relevant context data is algorithmically selected, comprising a monetary cost of the context data.
A sensor that obtains context-data physically.<SEP>A sensor by which context data is obtained.

A protocol according to which the relevant context data and the short message are formatted; may comprise a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.<SEP>A protocol according to which relevant context data and a short message are formatted, such as a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.
A type of communication protocol used for formatting the context data and short message.<SEP>A communication protocol comprising a cellular network short message protocol.
A type of communication protocol used for formatting the context data and short message.<SEP>A communication protocol comprising an internet communication protocol.
A list of context-data elements weighted according to at least one metric, from which context data is selected.
Data obtained by a physical sensor that is linked to a short message and formatted according to a communication protocol.
A cost associated with the context-data that a context-data provider is allowed to provide.
A device that generated the short message and has a physical context to which the context data is related.

edges.description: The patent US8509827B2 discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture of context-data acquisition and ranking.
The method algorithmically determines a context-data type from a query or from the meaning of a term of a short message.
The method identifies at least one context-data source providing the context-data type, ranks the source according to a specified parameter, and generates a request for context data from the source.
The method acquires and ranks received context data and provides it to devices or associates it with a short message.
The method ranks context-data sources according to a specified parameter.
The method receives a short message, determines context-data type from its term meaning, and may append context data to it.
The method provides received context data to the device that generated the short message and to a recipient mobile device.
The method is performed with a server that receives the short message from a mobile device.
The method stores received context data in a database available to a recipient mobile device.
The method forwards a Uniform Resource Identifier of a database server to the receiving mobile device.
The method encodes received context data into the short message with a markup language.
The method appends metadata instructions to query the database for the received context data in the short message.
The server receives a short message from a mobile device.
The mobile device generates and sends the short message that is received.<SEP>The mobile device generates the short message and the query.
The short message and the received context data may be forwarded to the recipient mobile device.

The received context data may be associated with a component of the short message, appended to the short message, or encoded into it with a markup language.<SEP>Context data from the context-data source is appended to a short message generated by the mobile device, and relevant context data is linked to the short message.<SEP>The collected context data is related to a meaning of a short message content.
The context-data type is determined by the meaning of a term of the short message.
The computerized apparatus performs the operation of receiving a short message from a mobile device.
The processor executes instructions to perform the operation of receiving a short message from a mobile device.
The short message is formatted according to a communication protocol.<SEP>The short message is formatted with the relevant context data according to a communication protocol.
The relevant context data is linked to the short message.
The device generated the short message.
The received context data may be provided to the device that generated the short message.
The specified parameter may comprise a state of the receiving mobile device.
The context-data type provides information about the environment or context of the mobile device.<SEP>The context-data type provides information about an environment of the mobile device.
The mobile device that generated the short message may comprise a smart phone.
Context data is communicated through the communication network to the mobile device.
The server algorithmically determines the context-data type from the meaning of a term of the short message.
The server identifies and algorithmically ranks at least one context-data source according to a specified parameter.
The server generates a request for context data and receives context data from the context-data source.
At least one server collects a set of context data from at least one context-data provider.
The context-data source provides the context-data type.
The computerized apparatus algorithmically determines the context-data type.
The processor algorithmically determines a context-data type based on the meaning of a term of the short message.
The context-data source is algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter.<SEP>The context-data source is ranked according to a specified parameter.
The context data is provided by the context-data source.<SEP>A request for context data of the context-data type is generated to the context-data source.
The computerized apparatus identifies and algorithmically ranks the context-data source according to a specified parameter.
The processor identifies at least one context-data source providing the context-data type and algorithmically ranks it according to a specified parameter.
The received context data may be provided to a recipient mobile device.
The received context data may be stored in a database available to a recipient mobile device.

The specified parameter may comprise a cost value of the context data provided by the context-data source.<SEP>The specified parameter comprises a pecuniary cost to acquire context data from the context-data source.
The database server is queried for the received context data in the short message.
The processor generates a request for context data of the context-data type to the context-data source.
Context data from the context-data source is rendered for communication through the communication network to a mobile device.
The context data is selected from a list of context-data elements weighted according to at least one metric.
Relevant context data is algorithmically selected according to a metric.<SEP>The metric comprises a monetary cost of the context data.
The context data is obtained by a physical sensor.
The relevant context data and the short message are formatted according to a communication protocol.
The specified parameter comprises a pecuniary cost to acquire context data from the context-data source.

The database server is identified by a Uniform Resource Identifier that may be forwarded to the receiving mobile device.
The metadata instructions are appended to query the database for the received context data.

The computerized apparatus comprises at least one processor configured to execute program instructions.
The computerized apparatus comprises at least one memory having program instructions.
The processor is configured to execute the program instructions held in the memory.
The processor is configured to execute the program instructions to perform the described operations.
The context-data provider is allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.
The context-data is obtained by a physical sensor.

The communication protocol comprises an internet communication protocol.
